transliteration_iast: karmaṇy evādhikāras te mā phaleṣu kadācana
english_translation: You have a right to action alone, never to its fruits.

sanskrit_devanagari: न जायते म्रियते वा कदाचिन् नायं भूत्वा भविता वा न भूयः ।
transliteration_iast: na jāyate mriyate vā kadācin nāyaṃ bhūtvā bhavitā vā na bhūyaḥ
english_translation: The self is not born, nor does it die.
Yoga is the cessation of the fluctuations of the mind.

transliteration_iast: īśāvāsyam idaṃ sarvaṃ yat kiñca jagatyāṃ jagat
english_translation: All this, whatever moves in this moving world, is enveloped by the Lord.
